subject: Ecosystem onboarding: revenue-share split + ops playbook
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <partnerships@atlasint.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Ecosystem onboarding: revenue-share split + ops playbook

Hi Samir — great to meet last week. Following up with a concise proposal so we can lock scope quickly and get a pilot going. High-level commercial + ops we suggest: 

• Commercials (pilot / first 12 months): 60/40 revenue split (Atlas/Redwood) on billed usage for customers introduced by Atlas.
• Post-pilot normalization: after 12 months, a transition to a 70/30 split in favour of Redwood unless ARR thresholds are met (we're happy to build explicit uplift brackets).
• Intro capture window: 90 days from first inbound (defined by HubSpot lead ID / UTM + DocuSign introduction).
• Trial/credits: Redwood will provide a one-time onboarding credit equivalent to $1,200 in billable usage per customer; credits are not revenue-shareable. Free-tier usage is excluded.
• Territory & exclusivity: non-exclusive; we can discuss vertical carve-outs if you have priority accounts.
• Ops & reporting: Atlas will get a monthly revenue/usage report and a shared lead-register (CSV) we will validate. Disputes resolved via our intake doc within 15 business days.

I attached a short ops checklist and a draft term summary (see attachments). Next steps I propose: 
1) You and legal give us redlines on the term doc by EOD Tuesday (6/1).
2) We finalize a lightweight SOW for the pilot and spin up the joint onboarding Deck + CS playbook.
3) Sign and schedule first enablement call the week of 6/7.

If any of the above is a blocker, call me and we'll walk through it.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124
Redwood Inference

Attachments: integrator-revshare-draft-20270529.pdf, ops-onboarding-checklist-ATLAS.xlsx

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@atlasint.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: partnerships@atlasint.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Ecosystem onboarding: revenue-share split + ops playbook

Mina — thanks for the clear summary and the materials. Quick initial thoughts:

• Commercial split: 60/40 pilot sounds reasonable. We do want one conditional uplift clause tied to first-year net-new ARR > $250k so the partner split steps up by 5% for Atlas.
• Intro capture: 90 days is tight for some of our larger enterprise motions. Can we extend to 120 days for opportunities where Atlas delivers a formal SOW?
• Trials/credits: agree credits should be out of the split. Need clarification on how credits show up in invoicing (gross vs net).
• Reporting cadence: monthly is fine. We will need a field-level mapping (HubSpot -> Redwood CSV) so our ops team can automate ingestion.

I've attached a short redline with the three items above: atlas-redwood-term-redline-20270530.docx. Also looping in our deal lead, Jordan (cc'd on the doc), who will own validation on our side.

Can you confirm Redwood's expected lead-dispute SLAs and whether you have an existing tracker template?

—Samir
Samir Patel
Director, Partnerships | Atlas Integrations
partnerships@atlasint.com | +1 212-555-0789

Attachment: atlas-redwood-term-redline-20270530.docx

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Ecosystem onboarding: revenue-share split + ops playbook

Team — forwarding Samir's redline. Quick internal plan and asks below (call it negotiation play):

> From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@atlasint.com>
> Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:03:00 -0400
> Subject: Re: Ecosystem onboarding: revenue-share split + ops playbook
> 
> (redline attached)

My recommended responses: 
1) Accept 60/40 for pilot, include a 5% uplift for Atlas if first-year net-new ARR contributed by Atlas > $250k (excludes credits).
2) Make intro capture window 120 days but tiered: 90 days standard, 120 days if Atlas submits an SOW (SOW to be time-stamped and added to the lead CSV).
3) Invoicing: credits applied as a pre-billing credit (i.e., they reduce gross billable tokens before revenue split). Call this out explicitly in the SOW.
4) Provide Atlas with the tracker template (simple CSV with HubSpot lead ID, first touch date, DocuSign link). Ben, can you produce the tracker and the monthly import mapping?
5) Camila, please draft a customer-facing onboarding checklist for the pilot (config items, SLA expectations, enablement slots).

I'm planning to send a short reply to Samir Monday morning with the bulletized concessions + DocuSign summary. If legal needs to add language for the uplift clause we can add one short paragraph rather than renegotiating the whole doc.

Camila: are there any operational blockers for 120-day window? Ben: time to deliver the tracker?

—Mina

Cc'd responses:
Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>: "Ack. Will draft the customer checklist and highlight any CS dependencies by EOD Monday."
Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>: "I'll deliver CSV tracker + mapping spec by Tuesday morning. Will include sample ingestion script."

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Atlas Integrations <partnerships@atlasint.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ecosystem onboarding: revenue-share split + ops playbook

Samir — thanks for the quick turnaround and the redlines. We discussed internally and agree to the following updated terms for the pilot: 

• Pilot commercial summary (agreed): 60/40 Atlas/Redwood for pilot (12 months). Atlas earns an additional 5% uplift if net-new ARR contributed by Atlas in the first 12 months > $250k (excludes credits and promotional usage).
• Intro capture: default 90 days, 120 days where Atlas submits a dated SOW or signed proposal; that SOW must be included in the lead CSV at time of submission.
• Credits: Redwood onboarding credit ($1,200) applied as pre-billing credit — reduces gross billable usage prior to splits. We will include explicit invoicing examples in the final SOW.
• Ops: attached is the onboarding checklist and the CSV tracker template. We'll share an ingestion script and a monthly report export. Dispute intake window: 15 business days from monthly statement issuance.

Next steps: 
1) I uploaded a one-page term summary and a DocuSign envelope for the pilot commercial appendix: https://docs.redwood.com/s/ecosystem-onboarding-playbook-v1 (click "Sign pilot appendix").
2) If that looks good, please sign the DocuSign by EOD Friday (6/4) so we can schedule enablement for the week of 6/7.
3) Ben to share CSV tracker mapping and sample ingestion script (expected Tue AM). Camila to share CS onboarding checklist (expected Mon EOD).

If you want the uplift clause tightened (specific measurement dates or lookback treatment), flag it and we'll get legal eyes. Otherwise we believe this is a pragmatic structure that lets both teams ramp quickly.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the pilot underway.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124
